title: HLSE Text Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json text <input>`. Fields marked required are always present; all others are conditional on score band or available signals.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

target.description: First 120 characters of the analysed text (JSON-escaped).

action.description: Human-readable band for the score. Prefer `severity` for numeric routing.

severity.description: Monotonic CVSS-aligned band integer: 0=SAFE 1=LOG 2=ALERT 3=BLOCK 4=ISOLATE. Use `severity >= 3` for 'actionable' gates — stable against future tier insertions.

signal_count.description: Number of independent signal categories that fired. Present when score > 0.

confidence.description: Qualitative label for signal corroboration. Present when score > 0.

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect for text analysis — present when score 0.

pattern.description: Human-readable social-engineering attack-pattern label. Present when score > 0 and a recognisable pattern was found. May be refined across versions; use pattern_id for stable routing.

pattern_id.description: Stable append-only SIEM/SOAR routing token. Present iff `pattern` is present. Never changes meaning once issued.

objective.description: The attacker's specific asset target (score >= 60 only).

verify.description: The single pre-action check to perform before complying (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above; co-occurs with exoneration in the 40-59 overlap).

triage.description: 60-second post-response action to minimise damage (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other accounts and assets at risk beyond the primary target (score >= 60 only).

exoneration.description: Benign explanation and falsifying test for borderline scores (score 15–59 only).

channel_delta.description: Score adjustment applied by the channel prior.

channel_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the channel prior adjustment.

reasons.description: Per-signal detector reasons. Empty array for SAFE verdicts.
